summary: Say what this build can actually do, and stop calling an install with no model a permanent data loss

coordination.notes: A9 adds one field to the existing status rather than a parallel counter, and the panel keys the danger-ink paragraph on availability instead of gaining a second loss display. The check that the panel's promise matches the presence of src/lib/aiLocalProvider.ts is written so it will start demanding the other sentence the moment H1 lands the file - it asserts the pair, not today's answer, so it cannot go stale into a false pass. One thing worth recording: the A6 field-coverage guard was itself defective and this increment found it. It read Object.keys of a hand-written fixture, so a new status field was invisible to it - the exact failure it claims to prevent. It now reads the keys off a status runHostTick really produced, and reported the missing unreviewedWithoutModel case immediately.
